descriptions: The resource now checks for updates on startup and prints a changelog summary in the server console when a new version is available.
On startup, the resource verifies it is running under the correct folder name (`fs-pets`). If renamed, it will print a security alert and stop itself automatically.

Three new server-side exports for external script integration — `HasActivePet(src)`, `GetActivePet(src)` and `GetPetStats(src)`. Useful for checking pet state from minigames, events, or any other resource

Five new client-side exports — `HasActivePet()`, `GetActivePetEntity()`, `GetActivePetData()`, `GetActivePetStats()` and `IsPetSleeping()`. Scripts can now read pet state, grab the ped handle, or check stats without touching fs-pets internals.
